key_errors:
Warning: Failed to find package 'tools'
Error: The process '/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/20.0/bin/sdkmanager' failed with exit code 1
root_cause: The 'Setup Android SDK' step in .github/workflows/android.yml invokes android-actions/setup-android with packages: 'tools platform-tools'. The legacy 'tools' package has been removed from the Android SDK repository (dl.google.com), so sdkmanager cannot resolve it and exits with code 1, failing both CXX_Unit_Tests and CXX_Func_Tests identically. This is a pre-existing CI configuration issue on the releases/2026/4 branch, unrelated to this PR's docs-only changes. It is a recurrence of a failure already recorded on 2026-09-15 (run 35000889493, PR #38131) that has not yet been fixed on this branch; master already carries the fix (removing 'tools' from packages).
reproduction_steps: Run 'sdkmanager tools' with cmdline-tools version 20.0 against the current Android SDK repository; it returns 'Warning: Failed to find package tools' and exits non-zero, matching the CI log.
recommended_actions: Edit .github/workflows/android.yml on releases/2026/4 to change 'packages: tools platform-tools' to 'packages: platform-tools' in both Setup Android SDK steps (lines ~420 and ~517), matching the fix already present on master.
Re-run the merge-queue check once the workflow file is corrected; a plain retry will not fix this deterministic configuration issue.
prevention_strategies: When cherry-picking or syncing CI workflow fixes from master to release branches, ensure previously-fixed drift (like the 'tools' package removal) is ported. Consider a scheduled bot to diff shared workflow files between master and active release branches.
historical_context: Recurrence of pattern 973fc34b4fbdfed5, first recorded 2026-09-15T17:47:38Z on PR #38131 (run 35000889493), same 'Android' workflow, same releases/2026/4 branch. Not yet fixed at time of this run.
